title: Are you ready to order? — идиомы

items.example: We didn't have a reservation — can we have a table for two?
items.mnemonic: Табло светится a table for two — стол на двоих.

items.example: The waiter brought us a coffee on the house.
items.mnemonic: Хаски угощает on the house — за счёт заведения.

items.example: We left a big tip because the service was excellent.
items.mnemonic: Тип оставляет a big tip — щедрые чаевые.

items.example: Keep it simple — I'll just have the soup.
items.mnemonic: Без кипиша keep it simple — не усложнять.

items.example: The menu looks good. Go for it!
items.mnemonic: Меню как гонка: go for it — бери смело.

items.example: She doesn't eat much — she eats like a bird.
items.mnemonic: Птичка на берёзе to eat like a bird — есть очень мало.

items.example: Let me get a bite to eat before the film.
items.mnemonic: Кусочек с Байкала: a bite to eat — кусочек поесть.
